14.q: An issue report that a maintainer can act on contains:
14.hq: जिस इश्यू रिपोर्ट पर मेंटेनर काम कर सके उसमें:
opts: Steps to reproduce, expected vs actual, environment

14.q: When presenting technical work to non-technical people:
14.hq: गैर-तकनीकी लोगों को तकनीकी काम प्रस्तुत करते समय:
opts: Lead with the outcome and one analogy, then details on request

14.q: Estimating a task, a good practice is:
14.hq: काम का अनुमान लगाते समय अच्छा अभ्यास:
opts: Break it into small pieces and include testing time

14.q: Open-source licence compatibility matters because:
14.hq: ओपन-सोर्स लाइसेंस संगतता क्यों मायने रखती है:
opts: Some licences restrict how combined code may be distributed

14.q: Mentoring a learner who is stuck, the best first move is:
14.hq: अटके हुए सीखने वाले को मेंटर करते समय पहला कदम:
opts: Ask them to explain what they tried and where it broke

14.q: A retrospective is most useful when it:
14.hq: रेट्रोस्पेक्टिव सबसे उपयोगी तब है जब:
opts: Produces a few concrete actions with owners

14.q: Writing a style guide for a team helps because:
14.hq: टीम के लिए स्टाइल गाइड क्यों मदद करती है:
opts: Consistent docs and code reduce review time and confusion

14.q: When a project is behind schedule, the honest communication is:
14.hq: प्रोजेक्ट पीछे चलने पर ईमानदार संचार:
opts: Report early with options: cut scope, add time, or add help

14.q: Community moderation should prioritise:
14.hq: समुदाय मॉडरेशन में प्राथमिकता:
opts: Clear rules applied consistently and respectfully
